title: PlayStation 5 passes 100 million consoles shipped (sell-in) worldwide as of 10 Nov 2026, per Sony Interactive Entertainment's Business Data & Sales page (Gematsu, 11 Nov); 97.9 million at 30 Sep 2026; PS4 reached 100 million by 30 Jun 2019 (about 5 yrs 7 mo after its 15 Nov 2013 launch), PS5 launched 12 Nov 2020 (India 2 Feb 2021) and was still short at 30 Sep 2026; PS5 now 4th on Sony's all-time PlayStation hardware list
